target.title: improve(ui): move Sessions from the sidebar More menu into Settings
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Sessions page (active session keys, per-session overrides, transcript search) sat in the sidebar's customizable navigation, surfacing in the "More" popup next to day-to-day workspace destinations like Usage and Automations. It is session management/administration, not a page operators visit constantly, so it cluttered the main navigation while every other management surface (Worktrees, Activity, Channels, ...) already lives inside Settings.

## Why This Change Was Made

Sessions becomes a settings navigation route in the **Agents & Tools** group, following the same pattern used when Worktrees and Activity moved into Settings: canonical path `/settings/sessions` with the old `/sessions` path kept as a route alias so existing bookmarks and deep links (for example the chat pane's checkpoint link) keep working. Persisted sidebar pins referencing `sessions` are dropped automatically by the existing `normalizeSidebarPinnedRoutes` cleanup, so no migration is needed.

## User Impact

The sidebar "More" menu and pin editor no longer list Sessions; the page now appears in Settings under Agents & Tools (and in settings search). All existing `/sessions` URLs continue to resolve.

## Evidence

- `ui/src/app-navigation-groups.test.ts` gains a regression test that `sessions` is out of `SIDEBAR_NAV_ROUTES`, in `SETTINGS_NAVIGATION_ROUTES`, and stale pins are dropped.
- `ui/src/app-navigation.test.ts` covers the new canonical path + `/sessions` alias through the compiled router (same table as the other settings routes).
- `ui/src/e2e/sidebar-customization.e2e.test.ts` updated to pin/unpin Tasks instead of Sessions and to land on `/chat` (the sessions route now opens the settings takeover). It also repairs a breakage this test already had on `main`: #105777 replaced the sidebar footer Settings link with the agent-chip utility menu, and the test still queried the removed link (the ui-e2e lane is not in PR CI, and the scheduled repo-e2e lane currently fails earlier in the gateway suites, so this went unnoticed). The test now opens Settings through the agent chip menu.
- Blacksmith Testbox (`golden-krill-cc30`, delegated sync of the pushed head): touched unit suites `app-navigation`, `app-navigation-groups`, `settings.node`, `app-sidebar` — 133/133 passed; `sidebar-customization.e2e.test.ts` — 6/6 passed under real Chromium.
- Codex autoreview (gpt-5.6-sol, xhigh) on the final branch diff: clean, no findings ("patch is correct, 0.91").
- Hosted CI on the PR head — see checks.
